newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Deson to offer 75 mln shrs at HK$1.00/shr.
newsitem.headline: HK's Deson to offer 75 mln shrs at HK$1.00/shr.

text.p: Construction and property concern Deson Development International Holdings Ltd said on Monday it is issuing 75 million new shares at HK$1.00 each in an initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong.
The company said the issue accounted for about 25 percent of its enlarged share capital and that the issue price would represent a proforma fully diluted price/earnings multiple of 6.88 times.
It said the annual dividend yield is four percent and its adjusted net tangible asset value per share is HK$0.7701.
The IPO will run from May 27-30 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on June 10.
Pacific Challenge Capital Ltd is the sponor of the issue.

Hong Kong-based Deson Development is mainly engaged as a contractor in the construction of new buildings, interior decorations and project management in Beijing and Shanghai as well as the Chinese provinces of Shangdong, Zhejiang, Guangdong and Shenyang.
Deson is also engaged in property investments.

Of net proceeds estimated at about HK$62.5 million, HK$40 million will be used as investment for participation in the Economic Housing Scheme in China, HK$15 million to finance the construction business in China and HK$7.5 million for working capital, it said.
